applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Check the transaction page for the account's quoted fee and the transaction record for a fee already charged. The Portal fee ceilings in this service schedule are 0.3% for e-commerce accounts, 0.7% for developer accounts and 0.4% for B2B conversion payments. These are ceilings, not a promise that every transaction is charged at the ceiling.

Portal fee amounts use banker's rounding to two decimal places: an exact half is rounded to the even retained digit. Collection Profile products use their own published rounding and minimum-fee rules; CORE tariffs are also separate.

CedarPay does not charge a Portal incoming-payment fee. A marketplace, remitting bank or intermediary may deduct its own charge. For a discrepancy between the platform's gross payout and the amount received, obtain the platform and bank fee details.

Outgoing fees shown by CedarPay do not exclude additional intermediary or recipient-bank charges. Ordinary retention of a Portal account does not itself incur an opening or idle-account fee. A separately selected paid product remains subject to its own tariff.
